purpose: Index record for the STRICT current-WABA proof of qf_vendor_onboarding_reminder_v1. The 2026-08-24 truth sweep could only read this key through the QF-MVP-40-R7B classifier, which matches name, language and status ONLY: it asserted no category and no component comparison, so the key was the weakest of the five READY entries. This record points at the sanitized reconciliation the submitter generated on 2026-08-25, which closes that gap. The facts live in the referenced artifact and are deliberately NOT duplicated here.
privacy: This index holds no Meta identifier at all. The referenced artifact was written by the submitter's own sanitizer and carries no token, app secret, phone number or WABA id; it does carry the non-secret Meta template object id and the Meta request id, matching the precedent already set by meta-staging-start-ack-v2-approval-evidence. No Meta request or response body was captured, and none is reconstructed.

strict_evidence.note: Moved out of the repository root into docs/provider-manifests under the kebab-case convention. Content was NOT edited: the sha256 above is the sha256 of the file the submitter emitted.

identity_corroboration.observed_by: QF-MVP-40-R7B one-shot operator, DRY RUN mode
identity_corroboration.why: The submitter's reconcile branch proves only that the WABA self-identifies (idBody.id === QF_META_WABA_ID); it does not hash-pin the staging asset triple. R7B's dry run was run first in the same environment and reported identity authorised: true against its pinned App/WABA/phone digests, so the reconciliation above is proven to have addressed the dedicated staging WABA and not a shared or unknown one.

semantic_proof.derivation: RECONCILED_APPROVED is reachable in the RECONCILE_ONLY branch only after ALL of: the exact-name GET returned exactly one row matching name AND language; the remote category equals the pinned packet category (a difference exits RECONCILED_CATEGORY_MISMATCH); templatesAreIdentical(remoteRow, packet.creation_payload) returned true using the REMOTE components (a difference exits RECONCILED_COLLISION); the status is a known status and equals APPROVED; and a remote template id is present. The semantic match is therefore established by the operator's own control flow, not asserted independently.
semantic_proof.comparator: templatesAreIdentical / templateIdentity — the same canonical comparator used by the R7K, R7L, R7M and R7N one-shot classifiers.

zero_mutation_proof.derivation: The RECONCILE_ONLY branch is placed before all create logic and terminates unconditionally through finish(), so the single create POST in section G is unreachable in this mode. resolveMode() additionally rejects --execute together with --reconcile-only. The emitted record carries create_post_count 0.

authorities_explicitly_not_granted.statement: This is a reading. It grants nothing. It does not authorise creating any absent template, mapping any template, arming any provider, or any production action.
